text:
kevin: starting SolarisFin LoRA onboarding — quick-eval pushed to staging (job 7182). invoices + ledger rows, lots of currency symbols and parentheses. expect tokenization noise.
yasmin: plan: fp16 -> int8 -> int4. collect QA_F1, exact_match, amount_fuzz (new metric), avg_latency. ETA 90m.
otto: uploaded focused probe: /evals/solarisfin/ledger-numbers-v1.json (32 samples). includes negative parentheses, JPY, € with spaces.
kevin: fp16 local baseline: QA_F1=0.849, exact_match=0.69, amount_fuzz=0.97, latency=74ms.
yasmin: int8 staging run: QA_F1=0.842, exact_match=0.67, amount_fuzz=0.93, latency=59ms. probe fails 7/32 — main failure: comma separators and missing space before currency code.
otto: example fail: source "Balance: (1,250) USD" -> model output "(1250USD)" -> checker flagged. looks like token concat differences.
kevin: low-risk fix: add scoring canonicalizer `amount_normalize()` that strips interior commas and enforces space before currency for comparator only. will PR to eval harness.
yasmin: also add token-id dump on failures to s3://redwood-debug/solarisfin/7182/fails.log so we can audit decode path.
ci-bot: job 7182 queued: int4 run on node gpu-small-12 (ETA 8m).
otto: pushed PR #1420 adding amount_normalize and tokenid logging. running int8+int4 again.
yasmin: after canonicalizer: int8 QA_F1=0.845, probe failures 2/32. int4 QA_F1=0.821, probe failures 5/32. canonicalizer removed majority of false negatives.
kevin: decision: promote int8 as canary, keep int4 behind experimental flag. owners: yasmin -> quant passes + CI alerts, otto -> probe curation + PR, kevin -> release note + rollback steps.
devops-bot: note: canary alert set: block promotion if amount_fuzz drops by >1.5% vs baseline.
yasmin: will follow up with a deeper decode trace task to investigate embedding rounding in int4. closing thread unless new failures surface. :white_check_mark:
